AWARENESS PROGRAM ON ANTI RAGGING 
 
Name of Activity : Anti-Ragging 
 
Need of the Activity : To educate the students in terms of ragging and its consequences 
 
 
The NSS Unit of S V College of Engineering has conducted the awareness programme on Anti -Ragging by 
Mrs. Anju Yadav, C.I, Renigunta, to the all students’ community. Madam inspires a lot regarding  healthy 
life style without involving any ragging activities in education life. And also explaining the  consequences of 
ragging in all aspects with so many real life examples during her service. 
The following photographs are attached for your kind perusal

NSS DAY 
Name of Activity : NSS DAY CELEBRATION-BOOKS DISTRIBUTION 
 
Need of the Activity : Celebrating NSS day with students in nearby villages. 
 
NSS unit celebrated 54 th anniversary in nearby adopted village Venkatapuram. NSS volunteers  
visited the Anganvadi schools and celebrated NSS day by cutting cake and Dr. T. Chandraiah NSS PO  of 
SV Colleges had distributed note books for children. After cake cutting volunteers dist ributed cake  and 
chocolate to the students. Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy had started the buses and donated the books for students

BLOOD DONATION CAMP 
 
Name of Activity : BLOOD DONATION CAMP 
 
Need of the Activity : To motivate NSS volunteers and students towards donating the blood to 
save lives. 
NSS Unit in association with We Are with You Charitable Trust conducted a blood donation camp in 
SV Colleges. Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy had started the camp by lightning the lamp. RUIA, Hospital  
management collected the blood by checking the donor’s health and details. Totally 210 units of blood  had 
collected. Refreshments were distributed to all the donors. It was the highest count of blood  collected 
compare to previous camps. NSS volunteers and WAY foundation together make the event grand success. 
Few photographs of the programme are attached herewith for kind perusal.
